ServiceAccount is a public non-human principal. Credentials stay private.

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `kudurru.io/v1alpha1` |
| Kind | `ServiceAccount` |
| Scope | Namespaced |
| Resource | `serviceaccounts.kudurru.io` |
| Short names | `ksa` |
| Subresources | `status` |

## Spec

ServiceAccountSpec is a non-human principal owning API tokens (§8.6).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.description` | `string` | Length: at most 2048 |
| `spec.disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled refuses every token of the account. |
| `spec.token` | `object` | ServiceAccountTokenSpec asks kudurru to keep a token for the account in a Secret in the operator credential namespace. |
| `spec.token.expiresAfter` | `string` |  |
| `spec.token.secretName` | `string` | Length: at most 253 |

## Status

ServiceAccountStatus records use.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.lastUsed` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.tokenID` | `string` |  |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_serviceaccount.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: automation
  namespace: dns
spec:
  description: DNS automation
```
